condition_rule: Inherit common_conditions and add claim conditions.

claims.conclusion: QFI identifies the finest QoS differentiation unit and is unique within that PDU Session; equal QFI receives equal forwarding treatment. QFI is not generally identical to 5QI; assignment rules are outside this topic.
5QI references forwarding characteristics; profile includes 5QI and ARP, plus UL/DL GFBR and MFBR for GBR flows.
ARP has priority, pre-emption capability and vulnerability; it supports accept/reject decisions and possible release of existing flows, not guaranteed admission.

limitations: Not an MCX traffic-class mapping, PCC rule implementation, 5QI table or EPS/5GS interworking verification.
Referenced TS23.502/23.503/24.501 mechanisms remain unchecked; V19.9.0 equivalence not asserted.
QFI assignment options and their ARP/N2 signalling conditions in §5.7.1.3 are not provided as configuration instructions.
